g.text: Entry points
State
Core
External
index.html · skeleton: controls aside, mobile tabs, two view divs
main.ts · builds controls and both views, owns the rAF loop
main.ts · resize and mobile tab switch, layout gated on width above zero
main.ts · playSpeed advances the datetime, notify capped at 10 per s
state.ts · one mutable object: place, datetime, playSpeed, 3 toggles
state.ts listeners · setters notify, but both loops rerun every frame anyway
surface lastPathKey · paths rebuild only when place, day or a toggle moved
no persistence · reload returns to 40.7 N, 74.0 W and now
astro/sun.ts · NOAA sunParams, solarPosition, sunTimes, ECEF and ENU
astro/sun.ts · tz-lookup zone, Intl parts, two-pass DST offset
seasonDates · Mar 20, Jun 21, Sep 22, Dec 21 at 12 UTC, no ephemeris
orbital.ts · sun fixed at world +X, Earth yaw is ecliptic longitude
orbital.ts · tilt is obliquity, spin yaw aligns ECEF sun with the tilted sun
orbital shader · smoothstep terminator, day times 1.75, night is city lights
orbital marker · pin, up and east and north axes, zenith wedge, subsolar
orbital terminator · great circle on the sun normal, label tips past 2.5 deg
orbital pointerup · raycast the sphere, then world to local to lat and lon
surface.ts · camera stays at the origin, yaw and pitch copy the sun
surface sky shader · dome and star opacity from sun elevation, twilight band
surface paths · sunENU sampled 72 times a day at radius 52, above horizon
surface analemma · same local clock every 2 days for a year, 12 beads
ui/controls.ts · panel, readouts, sliders, season jumps, GPS, collapse
public/textures · earth_day and earth_night jpg, three.js planet maps
tz-lookup · the whole IANA zone table compiled into the bundle
fonts.googleapis.com · DM Sans and IBM Plex Mono, two preconnects
navigator.geolocation · high accuracy, 10 s timeout, place and time
WebGL · two contexts, both still rendering after a mobile tab switch
GitHub Pages · workflow runs npm ci, tsc and vite build on push to main
